office_does: A Kitsap County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; the county's four district judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Claire A. Bradley, on the bench since 2014, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Kitsap County District Court judge since 2014 and presiding judge of its Behavioral Health Court; previously a deputy prosecutor for 17 years. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Judge since 2014; re-elected unopposed in 2018 and 2022 [S2][S3][S4]
Helped create and presides over the county's first mental health court [S1]
Deputy prosecutor 1997-2014, focused on crimes against children, sexual assault and domestic violence [S1]
